description: Shows the signed-in customer's own 4OVER4 print cart; use it when someone asks what is in their cart. It only reads the cart; items are added on www.4over4.com product pages. For past orders use get_my_orders. Takes no input. Returns the cart lines with product, quantity and price, the total and the checkout link on www.4over4.com. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "what is in my cart", "my cart total", "take me to checkout", "did my business cards stay in my cart".
name: get_cart

data.description: Cart lines, total and the checkout link on 4over4.com.

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.

summary.description: The facts of the result in plain sentences.

title: My 4OVER4 cart
